name: The Days We Felt Alive — Retro Catalog
notes: Music entries are complete albums, with selected songs listed as highlights.
Stock, prices and rental format are fictional shop inventory; release years describe the original work.

Thai artworks are AI-edited retro-frame variants. English artworks retain the original files and use a matching frontend frame. All original source images are retained for attribution and comparison.
